entry.summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 90 days.

consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Gaborone; Australian High Commission, Pretoria
consular.notes: There is an Australian Consulate in Botswana, which provides limited consular and passport assistance. The Australian High Commission in Pretoria, South Africa, can also provide consular assistance to Australians in Botswana.
